why: The HUD stops handing the strip's rule its resolved marker, so every FFA entry draws the `marks` row whatever the marker says (issue #1022). The reversal `?dev=1&identityMarker=solid` and every injected HUD would then draw the slot's outline in the strip with no `shape` outline on the ground to pair with, which is the one thing the ruling on #230 reserved `marks` against.
